text: Performance wording is now part of vision.md and mission.md: conceptual unity, statistical validity, and computational efficiency are coequal; exact algebraic elimination, factorization, sparsity, query fusion, streaming, and matrix-free action are pursued aggressively. Every optimized lowering owes oracle equivalence plus regime-specific runtime, peak-memory, and materialization evidence. Approximate, randomized, or reduced-precision algorithms require a distinct estimator identity and explicit error contract.
